Until a module lands, loop.ts tests use small fakes.

FINAL risk, with numbers (h07, lead). Per attempt on 30 seeds, keep rule on integration: a 2 sd gain with default runs 3 is kept 40/80 (50%); a 3 sd gain under heavy-tail noise (10% outliers of 6 sd) at runs 5 is kept 19/30 (63%); no-ops kept 1/128. FINAL needs 80% of gains. Cause: the Welch confirm look at 0.5% on 2x runs has low power at n=3, and outliers inflate the sd. Proposal for decide.ts (h07 owns it; I can do it if you want): (1) a sequential confirm: while the screen p stays < 10%, add fresh runs of both versions in batches up to about 4x runs, and stop at the 0.5% bar; (2) a rank-based or trimmed test so one outlier cannot hide a gain. The no-op rate must stay <= 5% (P06). Fixtures: PR #130 (small-gain-runs3, heavy-tail-noop). Also: P11 says a runner-up gain in a candidates round is never kept later (the menu proposer will not offer it again); if the frozen zoo counts those as gains, FINAL loses them.
